title: SWF DefineFont2: embed font glyphs for text display objects
description: Currently TextDisplayObject is exported as DefineEditText with device fonts (no embedding). Add proper font embedding via DefineFont2 (tag 48): (1) For each unique font face used in TextDisplayObject instances across the document, emit DefineFont2 with: GlyphCount, GlyphShapeTable (one DefineShape record per glyph), CodeTable (glyph-to-Unicode mapping), FontName, IsBold, IsItalic, IsANSI, IsShiftJIS, IsUnicode, Ascent/Descent/Leading metrics, AdvanceTable (horizontal advance per glyph), BoundsTable (glyph bounds), KerningCount + KerningRecords. (2) Update DefineEditText to reference the embedded font's charId via HasFont=1 + FontID + FontHeight instead of device font fallback. For MVP, embed only printable ASCII (32-126). Use a canvas element to measure glyph metrics (ctx.measureText) and to rasterize/trace glyph outlines via a CanvasPath approach or approximate with rectangles for non-graphic fonts. (3) Assign unique charIds for each font in the pre-pass. Add tests verifying DefineFont2 tag present, FontName matches, CodeTable has correct Unicode values. Only touches packages/swf/src/ — no authoring-ui changes.
